subject: [PATCH v3 01/11] scsi: mpt3sas: Don't leave requeued firmware events pending at teardown

2026-11-18.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the mpt3sas driver where firmware events were not properly cleaned up when the driver was torn down, leading to a use-after-free error. The fix involves canceling the delayed work of requeued events during cleanup and dropping references to prevent leaks. Additionally, the initialization of delayed work is moved to the allocation of fw_event_work structures to ensure it's initialized before requeueing.
